exposure: resection surgery for deep infiltrating endometriosis (DIE)
cohort: 55 reproductive-aged patients diagnosed with deep infiltrating endometriosis (DIE) who wished to conceive and underwent resection surgery, excluding those with other infertility factors or partner semen abnormalities.
finding: Surgical management of DIE was feasible and effective, resulting in a postoperative pregnancy rate of 61.82% in patients with pain and pregnancy intentions.
